method: Real local Worker, four isolated Chrome processes and ordinary pilot input. Different room seeds and host load: not a matched performance comparison. Functional pass does not prove input continuity or phone performance. Applied-ACK unacked counts are distinct from receipt-ACK inFlight.
activeDefinition: For World samples: alive, combat/boss and serverNow > resumeUntil + 1. For send gaps: both ends in that phase/grace with unchanged resumeUntil. Synthetic release uses the first outbound neutral and its receipt ACK; it is not visible character response.
